data.why: The repo bundles canonical growth/colony/antibiotic example CSVs matching the app's expected column names; a written file adds a missing value and an outlier (312 vs ~30-45) to exercise the cleaning/warning path the README describes.

goals: Upload a bacterial growth curve dataset and obtain initial count, final count, growth rate, growth factor, and a growth plot
Upload a plate colony count dataset and obtain mean, min, max, and standard deviation of colonies per plate plus a bar chart
Upload an antibiotic-vs-control dataset and obtain the final counts for each group and the percent reduction in bacterial growth from the antibiotic
Upload a dataset with a missing value and confirm the app drops and flags the affected row before analysis
Download a text and a PDF report summarizing the computed statistics for an uploaded dataset

review.summary: The tree states the app's purpose exactly (upload, clean, auto-detect, compute stats, plot, report), and all ten screens I opened match their nodes. A few small structural fixes are needed: fold the redundant 'recompute' task into the cleaning task, cover the undetected-format path, and drop the generic Streamlit table-toolbar feature.
